subject: Energy
title: Lifecycle Emissions
description: Learn Lifecycle Emissions in one minute.

hook.text: Lifecycle emissions count everything—from manufacturing to operation to decommissioning, not just the burning of fuel.

buildup.text: Coal emits about 820 gCO₂/kWh over its lifecycle—gas about 490, nuclear about 12, wind about 11, solar about 20.

discovery.text: Even including manufacturing, renewables emit 40–100x less than fossil fuels over their full lifecycle.

twist.text: Natural gas is marketed as a 'bridge fuel'—but methane leaks during extraction can erase much of its climate advantage.

climax.text: Lifecycle analysis gives the truest comparison—and renewables win decisively on every emissions metric.

punchline.text: Count every gram of CO₂—renewables still win by 40x.

quiz.question: How do renewable lifecycle emissions compare to fossil fuels?
